caption: The video captures a single pink ball airborne in front of a plain off-white wall, initially positioned above a light mat on a wooden floor. Over the opening moments it drifts downward toward the surface. As it nears the mat, a soft shadow appears beneath it, tracking its descent. Early on, the ball meets the mat and flattens into a wide squash shape before springing back to a round form and lifting just above the surface. For a long stretch it hangs at a low, nearly steady height, with a faint shadow remaining visible beneath it. The ball then settles back down to a second contact, squashing flat once more. After rebounding to a round silhouette it rises only slightly, ending hovering a short distance above the mat. Throughout, the wall and mat remain still, so the visible motion belongs entirely to the bouncing ball.
